rateLimits.note: Production: 60 requests a minute on every endpoint (sandbox: 30; the factory declares the sandbox's figures when sandbox is true)
Production: 1,200 requests an hour on every endpoint (sandbox: 200)

provenance.notes: Yousign is now Youtrust (developers.yousign.com redirects to developers.youtrust.com). Limits: 60 a minute and 1,200 an hour in production, 30 and 200 in the sandbox, per minute and per hour on all endpoints, plus 100 signature requests activated a day in the sandbox during the API trial; higher limits on request. Each answer carries x-ratelimit-limit-minute, x-ratelimit-remaining-minute, x-ratelimit-limit-hour, x-ratelimit-remaining-hour and Ratelimit-Reset (seconds to the minute's reset); a 429 says "Too many requests". Other quotas (developers.youtrust.com/docs/limits-new): 50 MB a document, 50 documents, 100 signers (5 in the sandbox trial), 10 approvers, 500 fields per signature request; a signature_link lasts 48 hours by default. Commercial use: under a paid API plan (a subscription contract); the current Conditions Générales d'Abonnement et d'Utilisation were not readable online, so storage, caching and redistribution stay unknown and no attribution is known to be required. Price: per plan, not read.
